title: Hudson Women's Nico Mid-Rise Straight Ankle Jean

comparisons.notes: Nico Mid-Rise Straight Ankle in Penny wash, sale price $77 (reg. $175)

writeup: Hudson's Nico Mid-Rise Straight Ankle jean is $36.99 on Woot across several washes and sizes. Hudson's own site has the Penny wash on sale for $77, so the Penny pair here is about 52% less. Other washes like Rescue and Black Ash Destruct are the same price on Woot.
